calls.summary: Marcus Bell called to switch from his current provider to Vyve Gig WiFi with the two-year price lock. Lila confirmed serviceability at his address, applied coupon code VYVEEQUIP for the included eero whole-home WiFi, and scheduled his installation for the following week. Marcus was thrilled with the smooth setup.

Nadia Frost asked about a mid-tier plan for her larger household with several streaming devices. Rosey recommended Vyve 500 with the unlimited-data option and walked her through the autopay discount. Nadia agreed and Rosey scheduled her installation, confirming the WiFi gateway would be included.

Priya Ramesh wanted both fast internet and streaming TV without a satellite dish. Oscar bundled Vyve Gig WiFi with DIRECTV STREAM, explained the cloud DVR and live local channels, and locked in the price for two years. He scheduled her installation and she was very satisfied.

Derek Holloway called as a brand new customer to sign up for the Vyve 300 entry plan after seeing an ad. Lee collected his full name, service address, and contact details, confirmed the 12-month promo rate and autopay discount eligibility, then scheduled his installation. Derek appreciated the clear intake process.

Sandra Quill was setting up service in a two-story home and needed strong coverage upstairs and down. Mary recommended Vyve 100 paired with eero Pro 7 mesh WiFi and explained the app-based management. Sandra signed up and Mary scheduled her installation.

Tom Alvarez called with a billing question after noticing an extra charge on his statement. Sue explained the 2.5% card fee applies to card payments and that switching to ACH or check payment avoids it. Tom understood and asked to update his payment method to ACH.

Grace Nolan called to check the status of her pending installation, which had not yet been confirmed. Mike located her order, verified the technician window, and sent a confirmation text. Grace was reassured but wanted the appointment sooner.

Victor Shaw reported that several channels were missing from his DIRECTV STREAM package. Jennifer walked him through a signal refresh and confirmed his lineup, restoring most channels. She opened a follow-up ticket for the remaining local channel issue.

Elaine Prophet called the business line to set up connectivity for a new office location. Rose reviewed Vyve Business Internet options with static IP and business-grade support, then scheduled the installation. Elaine was satisfied but wanted faster turnaround.

Hugh Barrera reported an intermittent connection dropping several times a day. Mike ran remote diagnostics, confirmed a line fault, and dispatched a technician under the Service Protection Plan. Hugh was frustrated it had taken multiple calls to resolve.

Rita Combs called to cancel her service because she is moving out of the coverage area. Sue offered the Moving option to transfer service but her new address was not serviceable. Rita proceeded with the cancellation and asked about the final bill.

Frank Osei disputed a billing charge, claiming his promo rate had expired earlier than promised. Lila reviewed the account and explained the regular rate applied after the 12-month promo period. Frank remained unhappy and requested a supervisor callback.

Denise Hyatt called to cancel after repeated outages over the past month. Oscar apologized and offered a credit and a technician visit, but she declined and insisted on ending service. The call ended with the cancellation processed.

Owen Pryce complained that his eero mesh nodes kept dropping and his WiFi was unusable in parts of the house. Lee attempted a reset and node repositioning but the issue persisted. Owen was angry and demanded a replacement eero unit shipped immediately.

Lena Voss called after hours to reschedule her upcoming installation, but the line rolled to voicemail. She left a message with her account number and a request for a callback. No agent was available to assist.

prompts.question: Is the customer trying to solve a specific problem?
prompts.answer: The caller is a new resident moving to the area and needs reliable high speed internet for working from home and streaming. They want a straightforward installation without complications.

prompts.question: What are the customer's expectations?
prompts.answer: The customer expects fast speeds, competitive pricing, and a prompt installation. They value price lock guarantees and want to avoid hidden fees during the signup process.

prompts.question: How could the agent handle the call better?
prompts.answer: Marcus could have captured the email address for account setup and explained the 2.5 percent card fee disclosure. He should also have offered the eero mesh WiFi bundle to ensure coverage throughout their new home.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks for calling Vyve Broadband. This is Marcus. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Hi Marcus. Yeah I just moved to the area and I need to get internet set up at my new place. Do you guys service my neighborhood?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Great question. I can definitely help you get connected. Can I grab your ZIP code so I can check our service map?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Sure, it's 28209.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Perfect. Yes, we have excellent coverage in that area with fiber and hybrid options. What's your full name?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Sarah Mendez. M-E-N-D-E-Z.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Sarah, thank you. And how many people are in your household? That helps me recommend the right speed tier.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: It's just me and my partner. We both work from home though, so we need something fast and reliable.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Got it. For two remote workers, I'd recommend our Vyve Gig WiFi plan. You get up to 942 megabits download, unlimited data, and we include the eero mesh system for two years. Plus there's a two year price lock at 74.99 a month.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: That sounds good. What about installation? How quick can you get a tech out there?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: We can have you installed within the next week. I have availability for Tuesday the 28th between 8 AM and noon. Does that work for your schedule?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Yes, Tuesday morning is perfect. That gives me time to get set up before I start my new job.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Excellent. Sarah, I have you scheduled for October 28th in the morning window. Your confirmation will come via text to the number you called from. We're all set here. Is there anything else before we wrap up?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: No, that covers it. Thanks for making this easy.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You're welcome, Sarah. Welcome to Vyve Broadband. Have a great day.

callDetail.aiSummary: Sarah Mendez, a new resident in the 28209 service area, called to schedule fiber internet installation for her home. Marcus verified Vyve's availability, qualified her for the Vyve Gig WiFi plan based on her household's remote work needs, and booked a Tuesday morning installation appointment within the standard service window. The call was efficient and friendly, though the agent did not capture an email address or discuss pricing details such as the card payment fee or promotional terms in depth.

comment.author: Kyle Paklaian
comment.text: @Marcus, great job structuring the call and moving through the installation intake smoothly. You nailed the service area verification and appointment booking. Two coaching points for next time: grab the customer's email address so our account team can send the MyVyve login and pre-installation prep docs. Also, be sure to mention the 2.5 percent fee that applies to card payments so there are no surprises when she pays the first bill. Well done overall.

qaPairs.question: Is Vyve Broadband available at my address?
qaPairs.answer: We serve many smaller and rural markets across the Southeast, Mid-South, and Northwest. Share your ZIP code and I'll confirm availability, then set up a quick consultation to lock in your plan.

qaPairs.question: How fast is the Vyve Gig plan?
qaPairs.answer: Our Gig service reaches a maximum of 960 Mbps and typically delivers around 942 Mbps download and 48 Mbps upload. I can book a specialist call to confirm what's available at your address.

qaPairs.question: What Internet plans do you offer?
qaPairs.answer: We have Vyve 100, Vyve 300, Vyve 500, and Vyve Gig WiFi to fit light to heavy households. Let's set up a short consultation so a specialist can match the right tier and give you an exact quote.

qaPairs.question: How much does Vyve Internet cost?
qaPairs.answer: Pricing depends on the tier, promo, and any add-ons like TV or Phone, so I can share a rough range and then a specialist will confirm the exact price. Want me to schedule that consultation?

qaPairs.question: Do you include WiFi equipment?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, our plans include a WiFi gateway, and the Gig plan can include eero whole-home WiFi and equipment with code VYVEEQUIP. I can book an install to get you set up.

qaPairs.question: What is eero whole-home WiFi?
qaPairs.answer: eero Pro 7 mesh covers every room, upstairs, downstairs, and even outside, with app-based management and Alexa integration. Let's schedule an install and a specialist can add it to your plan.

qaPairs.question: Do you have a data cap?
qaPairs.answer: Our Gig plans include unlimited data, and other tiers offer generous or unlimited-data options depending on the plan. I can set up a consultation to review the best fit for you.

qaPairs.question: Can I bundle TV with my Internet?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, you can add DIRECTV STREAM to your Internet for live channels, sports, local networks, and cloud DVR with no satellite dish. Let's book a call and a specialist will price your bundle.

qaPairs.question: Do you offer home phone service?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, Vyve Home Phone includes unlimited local and long-distance calling, voicemail, and caller ID. I can schedule a consultation to add it to your service.

qaPairs.question: Is there a low-cost Internet option?
qaPairs.answer: Essentials Connect offers reduced-price broadband with basic WiFi for qualifying households. Let's set up a consultation to check your eligibility and get you connected.

qaPairs.question: Do you require a contract?
qaPairs.answer: Our Gig WiFi plan comes with a two-year price lock, and other tiers have flexible terms with promo pricing. A specialist can walk you through the details on a quick call, want me to book one?

qaPairs.question: How long is the promo price good for?
qaPairs.answer: Some tiers like Vyve 300 apply a rate discount for 12 months, after which regular rates apply, while Gig WiFi offers a two-year price lock. Let's schedule a consultation to confirm the terms for your plan.

qaPairs.question: Can I get service for my business?
qaPairs.answer: Vyve Business Services offers commercial Internet with static IP options and business-grade support, plus multi-line business phone. I can arrange a consultation with our business team, want me to set that up?

qaPairs.question: Do you offer whole-home coverage for a large house?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, our higher tiers with eero mesh cover larger homes room to room, even outdoors. Let's book an install and a specialist can size the right setup for your home.

qaPairs.question: How do I switch from my current provider?
qaPairs.answer: Switching is easy and we can schedule an install that fits your timeline. Share your ZIP code and I'll confirm service, then set up your consultation.

qaPairs.question: Do you offer a referral reward?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, our Refer-a-Friend program gives a statement credit, and the more you share the more you save. Let's get you connected first, then I can note the referral on your account.

qaPairs.question: How soon can I get installed?
qaPairs.answer: Install timing depends on your area and the schedule, and I can find the soonest opening for you. Give me your ZIP code and I'll set up your appointment.

qaPairs.question: What speed do I need for streaming and gaming?
qaPairs.answer: For heavy streaming and gaming, our Vyve 500 or Gig plans give plenty of headroom for many devices. Let's book a consultation and a specialist will recommend the right tier.

qaPairs.question: Are there fees for paying by card?
qaPairs.answer: There is a 2.5% card fee on all card payments, while ACH transfer or check payments avoid that fee. I can help you set up autopay by bank draft when we schedule your install.

qaPairs.question: Can I add wiring protection?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, our Service Protection Plan covers inside wiring with priority service for a small monthly add-on. A specialist can include it when we book your installation, want me to set that up?
